summary: Alec Orenstein (37) tumbled ~1,200 ft skiing the Coors Couloir on Wilson Peak after hitting rocks; broke vertebrae, ribs and pelvis with a small pneumothorax; wife called San Miguel County SAR and a helicopter picked him up.
notes: ANAC 2022 edition (Pub 2022); incident date Apr 20 per article. Sheriff/SnowBrains account (matches on Tuesday 2021-04-20, age 37, Wilson Peak north face): New Mexico man; fell ~2,000 vertical ft near the summit and could not arrest the fall; partner uninjured; deputies called ~1 p.m.; air resources; helo to Telluride airport just after 4 p.m., ambulance to Telluride Medical Center, released from Montrose Memorial Hospital the next day; ~12 rescuers, ~5-hour mission; subject credited his helmet with saving his life.
